decision.justification: Selected 'trimmed_mean on pool2' (a seeded deterministic baseline) as the best of 22 backtested attempts, score -0.1122. Series context: trend strength 0.9991 and seasonal strength 1.0; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.384); 5 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 1.032.
